title: Taking, harming, or killing a Hawaiian hawk; prohibited.
bodyText: Except as otherwise provided in section 183D-62, the intentional taking, harming, or killing of an `io, or Hawaiian hawk (Buteo solitarius), shall be subject to penalties under section 195D-9.
bodyHtml: [§195D-4.7]  Taking, harming, or killing a Hawaiian hawk; prohibited.  Except as otherwise provided in section 183D-62, the intentional taking, harming, or killing of an `io, or Hawaiian hawk (Buteo solitarius), shall be subject to penalties under section 195D-9. [L 2025, c 98, §2]
